newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close sharply higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed sharply higher on Thursday on heavy buying of chemicals, telecom and power scrips by foreign buyers before Friday's religious holiday and the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 27.48 points, or 1.52 percent, higher at 1,840.26 amid 146 gainers and 105 losers at 13.30 (0830 GMT). ICI Pakistan rose 1.05 rupees to 29.70 on 62 million shares' trade, Pak Telecom 1.15 to 38.35 on 28 million shares and Hub Power 0.80 to 52 on 10 million shares.
The market will reopen on Monday. -Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
